description: Department of  Trade & Investment Policy - Order to impose Special Commodity Levy on Fish & Maize for 3 month period w.e.f. 01.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders specifying levy rates and time periods for specific commodities, which falls under the category of legal/regulatory matters (new regulations and statutory instruments). While it mentions a minister by name, the primary content is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure, so specialized Type 5 takes precedence over government-related types.
